description: This Java class implements the AlarmQueryRepository interface for querying alarm data from a SQL database within the Thingsboard platform. It constructs complex SQL queries with filtering, sorting, and pagination, and handles alarm-specific data fields and relationships.

classes.name: DefaultAlarmQueryRepository
classes.description: Repository class for executing SQL queries related to alarms, including filtering, sorting, and counting alarm data.

methods.name: findAlarmDataByQueryForEntities
methods.description: Executes a complex SQL query to retrieve paginated alarm data for specified entities based on the provided query parameters.

methods.name: countAlarmsByQuery
methods.description: Counts the total number of alarms matching the specified query criteria.

methods.name: buildTextSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs a SQL condition for text search across alarm fields.

methods.name: buildPermissionsQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions to enforce tenant permissions.

methods.name: addAndIfNeeded
methods.description: Helper method to append 'and' to SQL where clause if needed.
